expressions.title: The Balochistan Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1975
expressions.title_basis: p1 blocks 1016301-1016303 print 'THE BALOCHISTAN ASSEMBLY MEMBERS (SALARIES AND ALLOWANCES) ACT, 1975. (Amended upto 16th August, 2004)' -- the Provincial Assembly Secretariat's consolidation of the Act as amended to 16 Aug 2004, complete on pp1-8 (ss.1-10)

title_correction.from_title: The Balochistan Assembly Members (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act No. I of 2004
title_correction.basis: the catalogued file is the Assembly Secretariat's compilation: the Members Act 1975 consolidated to 16 Aug 2004 (pp1-8), the Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's Act 1975 consolidated (pp10-24) and the Members Act consolidated to 2007 (pp25-30); no amending Act of 2004 is printed in it

expressions.title: The Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
expressions.title_basis: p11 block 1016367 prints s.1(1) 'This Act may be called the Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975'; its preamble cites Article 250(1) for the Speaker and Deputy Speaker; complete on pp10-24 to the note 'Section 15-A amended vide Notification ...' (p24). The p10 heading and the p11 long title repeat the Members Act's (a compiler's error in the source).

expressions.title: The Balochistan Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1975
